# hetznerrobot_server (Data Source)

Reads one dedicated server, including which features (reset, Rescue System, installations, Wake on LAN) it supports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_server" "web" {
  server_number = 321
}

output "web_ipv6" {
  value = data.hetznerrobot_server.web.server_ipv6_net
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Server number.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the server is cancelled.
- `cpanel` (Boolean) Whether the cPanel installation is available.
- `dc` (String) Data center.
- `hot_swap` (Boolean) Whether hot swap is available.
- `ips` (List of String) Single IP addresses assigned to the server.
- `linked_storagebox` (Number) Id of the linked Storage Box, if any.
- `paid_until` (String) Paid-until date.
- `plesk` (Boolean) Whether the Plesk installation is available.
- `product` (String) Product name.
- `rescue` (Boolean) Whether the Rescue System is available.
- `reset` (Boolean) Whether the reset system is available.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IPv4 address; null on an IPv6-only server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net address.
- `server_name` (String) Name of the server.
- `status` (String) `ready` or `in process`.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets assigned to the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))
- `traffic` (String) Free traffic quota; `unlimited` for unlimited traffic.
- `vnc` (Boolean) Whether the VNC installation is available.
- `windows` (Boolean) Whether the Windows installation is available.
- `wol` (Boolean) Whether Wake on LAN is available.

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) Net address.
- `mask` (String) Prefix length.
